definition: a long gun you hold with two hands
description: A wide view of a biathlon range in flat winter light with a crowd of spectators packed behind the barriers. A female athlete in a green and blue race suit lies prone on a mat, the butt of her long rifle in her shoulder and her cheek against the stock, and shoots at five black targets set out on the snow in front of her. She holds the position through several shots, then lifts her head off the rifle and grins.

es.answer: Está apuntando con su rifle a las dianas.
